title: `docker/Dockerfile.linux` is a placeholder, not a real Dockerfile
what: The Linux container gate references `docker/Dockerfile.linux`, which is a placeholder.
why: Noted in DECISIONS.md during the 2026-11-03 round: `docker/Dockerfile.linux` is a placeholder and `docker/Dockerfile.linux` has no ruff, protoc, buf, bazelisk, pnpm or cargo.
impact: Linux gate cannot run end-to-end until the Dockerfile includes all needed tools.
